sections.label: To Agni, the sacred fire
sections.name: Mandala 1, hymn 1
intro: The opening hymn of the Rig Veda. Seer: Madhuchchhandas Vaishvamitra. Deity: Agni. Metre: Gayatri.

verses.sa: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम्। होतारं रत्नधातमम्॥
verses.tr: agnimīḻe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam
verses.en: I praise Agni, the household priest, the divine minister of the sacrifice, the invoker, the greatest giver of treasures.

verses.sa: अग्निः पूर्वेभिर्ऋषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत। स देवाँ एह वक्षति॥
verses.tr: agniḥ pūrvebhirṛṣibhirīḍyo nūtanairuta sa devāṃ eha vakṣati
verses.en: Agni, worthy of praise by the seers of old and by those of today: may he bring the gods here.

verses.sa: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत् पोषमेव दिवेदिवे। यशसं वीरवत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: agninā rayimaśnavat poṣameva divedive yaśasaṃ vīravattamam
verses.en: Through Agni one gains wealth and well-being, day after day, glorious and rich in brave sons.

verses.sa: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि। स इद् देवेषु गच्छति॥
verses.tr: agne yaṃ yajñamadhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūrasi sa id deveṣu gacchati
verses.en: O Agni, the worship and sacrifice that you surround on every side, that alone reaches the gods.

verses.sa: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः। देवो देवेभिरा गमत्॥
verses.tr: agnirhotā kavikratuḥ satyaścitraśravastamaḥ devo devebhirā gamat
verses.en: Agni, the invoker, with a poet's insight, true, most brilliantly renowned: may the god come with the gods.

verses.sa: यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि। तवेत् तत् सत्यमङ्गिरः॥
verses.tr: yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvamagne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi tavet tat satyamaṅgiraḥ
verses.en: Whatever good you will do for the one who worships you, O Agni, that is truly yours, O Angiras.

verses.sa: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम्। नमो भरन्त एमसि॥
verses.tr: upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam namo bharanta emasi
verses.en: To you, O Agni, day by day, you who light up the darkness, we come with our thoughts, bringing reverence,

verses.sa: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम्। वर्धमानं स्वे दमे॥
verses.tr: rājantamadhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim vardhamānaṃ sve dame
verses.en: to you, who rule over the sacrifices, guardian of the cosmic order (ṛta), shining, growing in your own home.

verses.sa: स नः पितेव सूनवे ऽग्ने सूपायनो भव। सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ piteva sūnave 'gne sūpāyano bhava sacasvā naḥ svastaye
verses.en: Be easy to approach for us, O Agni, as a father is to his son. Stay with us for our well-being.

sections.label: May auspicious thoughts come to us
sections.name: Mandala 1, hymn 89
intro: A prayer for blessings and a long, good life, recited at the start of many ceremonies. Its eighth verse, “Bhadram karnebhih”, is a well-known peace chant. Seer: Gotama Rahugana. Deity: All the gods.

verses.sa:
आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतो ऽदब्धासो अपरीतास उद्भिदः ।
देवा नो यथा सदमिद् वृधे असन्नप्रायुवो रक्षितारो दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr:
ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato 'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ 
devā no yathā sadamid vṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro divedive
verses.en: May auspicious thoughts come to us from every side, unhindered, unobstructed, breaking through; so that the gods may always be with us for our growth, our unfailing protectors day after day.

verses.sa:
देवानां भद्रा सुमतिर्ऋजूयतां देवानां रातिरभि नो नि वर्तताम् ।
देवानां सख्यमुप सेदिमा वयं देवा न आयुः प्र तिरन्तु जीवसे॥
verses.tr:
devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no ni vartatām 
devānāṃ sakhyamupa sedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase
verses.en: May the kindness of the gods, who love the upright, and the gifts of the gods turn towards us. We have sought the friendship of the gods; may the gods lengthen our lives, that we may live.

verses.sa:
तान् पूर्वया निविदा हूमहे वयं भगं मित्रमदितिं दक्षमस्रिधम् ।
अर्यमणं वरुणं सोममश्विना सरस्वती नः सुभगा मयस्करत्॥
verses.tr:
tān pūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham 
aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat
verses.en: With the ancient invocation we call on them: Bhaga, Mitra, Aditi, Daksha the unfailing, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma and the Ashvins. May blessed Sarasvati bring us joy.

verses.sa:
तन्नो वातो मयोभु वातु भेषजं तन्माता पृथिवी तत् पिता द्यौः ।
तद् ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवस्तदश्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या युवम्॥
verses.tr:
tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tat pitā dyauḥ 
tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam
verses.en: May the Wind blow healing to us that brings joy; may Mother Earth, may Father Heaven, may the stones that press the Soma bring it. Hear us, O wise Ashvins.

verses.sa:
तमीशानं जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियंजिन्वमवसे हूमहे वयम् ।
पूषा नो यथा वेदसामसद् वृधे रक्षिता पायुरदब्धः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr:
tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyaṃjinvamavase hūmahe vayam 
pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye
verses.en: We call for help on the Lord who rules all that moves and all that stands still, who inspires our thoughts; so that Pushan may increase our wealth, our guardian and protector, never harmed, for our well-being.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः ।
स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु॥
verses.tr:
svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ 
svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu
verses.en: May Indra, of great renown, grant us well-being. May Pushan, who knows all, grant us well-being. May Tarkshya, whose wheels are never broken, grant us well-being. May Brihaspati grant us well-being.

verses.sa:
पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः ।
अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसो विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्निह॥
verses.tr:
pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ 
agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamanniha
verses.en: The Maruts with their dappled horses, sons of Prishni, moving in splendour, who come to the gatherings, with tongues of flame, wise, with eyes like the sun: may all the gods come here to help us.

verses.sa:
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥
verses.tr:
bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ 
sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ
verses.en: May we hear with our ears what is auspicious, O gods. May we see with our eyes what is auspicious, O you who are worthy of worship. With strong limbs and bodies, praising you, may we live the full life the gods have given.

verses.sa:
शतमिन्नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् ।
पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर्गन्तोः॥
verses.tr:
śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām 
putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ
verses.en: A hundred autumns lie before us, O gods, within which you bring old age to our bodies, within which sons become fathers in their turn. Do not cut short our lives midway.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः ।
विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम्॥
verses.tr:
aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ 
viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam
verses.en: Aditi is heaven, Aditi is the air between. Aditi is mother, father and son. Aditi is all the gods and the five peoples. Aditi is all that has been born and all that will be born.

sections.label: To Savitr: the Gayatri
sections.name: Mandala 3, hymn 62
intro: Verses 10 to 12 of hymn 3.62. Verse 10 is the Gayatri Mantra, the most revered verse of the Vedas. Seer: Vishvamitra. Deity: Savitr, the divine light of the sun.

verses.sa: तत् सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
verses.tr: tat saviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
verses.en: We meditate on that excellent glory of the divine Savitr. May he inspire our thoughts.

verses.sa: देवस्य सवितुर्वयं वाजयन्तः पुरंध्या । भगस्य रातिमीमहे॥
verses.tr: devasya saviturvayaṃ vājayantaḥ puraṃdhyā bhagasya rātimīmahe
verses.en: Seeking strength, with abundant thought, we ask of the divine Savitr the gift of good fortune.

verses.sa: देवं नरः सवितारं विप्रा यज्ञैः सुवृक्तिभिः । नमस्यन्ति धियेषिताः॥
verses.tr: devaṃ naraḥ savitāraṃ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ
verses.en: People, inspired poets, honour the god Savitr with sacrifices and fine hymns, moved by their thought.

sections.label: The Purusha Sukta: the cosmic Person
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 90
intro: The hymn of the cosmic Person, from whose sacrifice the universe, the seasons, the Vedas and all beings arise. It is recited in temple worship across India. Seer: Narayana. Deity: Purusha.

verses.sa: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् । स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वाऽत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम्॥
verses.tr: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
verses.en: The Purusha has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Covering the earth on every side, he extends beyond it by ten fingers' breadth.

verses.sa: पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् । उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति॥
verses.tr: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
verses.en: The Purusha is all this, all that has been and all that will be. He is the lord of immortality, for he rises above all that grows by food.

verses.sa: एतावानस्य महिमाऽतो ज्यायाँश्च पूरुषः । पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि॥
verses.tr: etāvānasya mahimā'to jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi
verses.en: Such is his greatness, and the Purusha is greater still. All beings are one quarter of him; three quarters of him are the immortal in heaven.

verses.sa: त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः । ततो विष्वङ्व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि॥
verses.tr: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ tato viṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi
verses.en: With three quarters the Purusha rose on high; one quarter of him came into being here again. From there he spread out in every direction, into what eats and what does not eat.

verses.sa: तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः । स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः॥
verses.tr: tasmādvirāḻajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
verses.en: From him Viraj was born, and from Viraj the Purusha. As soon as he was born he reached beyond the earth, behind and before.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत । वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ
verses.en: When the gods performed the sacrifice with the Purusha as the offering, spring was its clarified butter, summer its fuel and autumn its oblation.

verses.sa: तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः । तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये॥
verses.tr: taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye
verses.en: On the sacred grass they consecrated that sacrifice, the Purusha born in the beginning. With him the gods, the Sadhyas and the seers performed the sacrifice.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम् । पशून्ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान्ग्राम्याश्च ये॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam paśūntāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye
verses.en: From that sacrifice, in which everything was offered, the clarified butter was gathered. From it he made the creatures of the air, of the forest and of the village.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे । छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata
verses.en: From that sacrifice, in which everything was offered, the verses (Rig) and the chants (Sama) were born. The metres were born from it, and from it the sacrificial formulas (Yajus) were born.

verses.sa: तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः । गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः॥
verses.tr: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ
verses.en: From it horses were born, and all creatures with two rows of teeth. Cattle were born from it, and from it goats and sheep.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् । मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete
verses.en: When they divided the Purusha, into how many parts did they arrange him? What was his mouth? What were his arms? What were his thighs and his feet called?

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः । ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata
verses.en: The Brahmin was his mouth; his arms became the Rajanya, the ruler; his thighs became the Vaishya; from his feet the Shudra was born.

verses.sa: चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत । मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत॥
verses.tr: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata
verses.en: The moon was born from his mind; from his eye the sun was born; from his mouth came Indra and Agni; from his breath the wind was born.

verses.sa: नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत । पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokāṃ akalpayan
verses.en: From his navel came the air between; from his head the sky arose; from his feet the earth, and from his ear the directions. So they shaped the worlds.

verses.sa: सप्तास्यासन्परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः । देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: saptāsyāsanparidhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum
verses.en: Seven were the enclosing sticks, thrice seven the sticks of fuel, when the gods, performing the sacrifice, bound the Purusha as the offering.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr:
yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan 
te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
verses.en: With the sacrifice the gods worshipped the sacrifice. These were the first sacred laws (dharmas). These great powers reached the vault of heaven, where the ancient Sadhyas, the gods, abide.

sections.label: Hiranyagarbha: the golden womb
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 121
intro: A hymn to the one creator, the Golden Germ from which the universe unfolds, asking in each verse: “To which god shall we offer our worship?” The answer comes in the last verse: Prajapati, Lord of creatures. Seer: Hiranyagarbha. Deity: Ka (Prajapati).

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् ।
स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt 
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In the beginning the Golden Germ arose. As soon as he was born he was the one lord of all that exists. He held up the earth and this sky. To which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ 
yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He who gives life, who gives strength, whose command all the gods obey; whose shadow is immortality, and whose shadow is death: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव ।
य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva 
ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He who by his greatness became the one king of all that breathes and blinks, who rules over all creatures with two feet and with four: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः ।
यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ 
yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He through whose greatness these snowy mountains exist, and the ocean with the heavenly river, as they say; whose arms are these quarters of the sky: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृळ्हा येन स्व स्तभितं येन नाकः ।
यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḻhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ 
yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He by whom the mighty sky and the earth were made firm, by whom the heavens and the vault above were propped up, who measures out space in the air between: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने ।
यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne 
yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He to whom heaven and earth, held up by his help, looked up with trembling minds; over whom the risen sun shines out: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन्गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम् ।
ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyangarbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim 
tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: When the great waters came, carrying all as a germ and giving birth to fire, from them arose the one life-breath of the gods: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम् ।
यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam 
yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He who in his greatness looked over the waters that carried strength and gave birth to sacrifice, who was the one god above all gods: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
मा नो हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा जजान ।
यश्चापश्चन्द्रा बृहतीर्जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr:
mā no hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna 
yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: May he not harm us, he who fathered the earth, who, true to his law, created the heavens and the bright, mighty waters: to which god shall we offer our worship?

verses.sa:
प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव ।
यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr:
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva 
yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: O Prajapati, no one but you embraces all these created things. May what we desire in worshipping you be ours. May we be masters of riches.

sections.label: The Devi Sukta: the Goddess speaks
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 125
intro: The seer Vak, daughter of Ambhrina, speaks as the Divine Mother who upholds all the gods and dwells in every being. It is recited before the Devi Mahatmya. Deity: the Self as the Goddess.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः ।
अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ 
ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā
verses.en: I move with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Adityas and all the gods. I uphold both Mitra and Varuna, I uphold Indra and Agni, and both the Ashvins.

verses.sa:
अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् ।
अहं दधामि द्रविणं हविष्मते सुप्राव्ये३ यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam 
ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye3 yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: I uphold the swelling Soma, and Tvashtar, Pushan and Bhaga. I give wealth to the devoted worshipper who brings offerings and presses the Soma.

verses.sa:
अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् ।
तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तीम्॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām 
tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm
verses.en: I am the queen, the gatherer of treasures, the knowing one, first among those worthy of worship. The gods have set me in many places, dwelling in many homes, entering into many things.

verses.sa:
मया सो अन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणिति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् ।
अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रद्धिवं ते वदामि॥
verses.tr:
mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam 
amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi
verses.en: Through me alone everyone eats, sees, breathes and hears what is spoken. Without knowing it, they dwell in me. Listen, you who are renowned: what I tell you is worthy of faith.

verses.sa:
अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवेभिरुत मानुषेभिः ।
यं कामये तंतमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम्॥
verses.tr:
ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ 
yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām
verses.en: I myself declare this, which gods and people alike rejoice in. Whomever I love, I make mighty; I make that one a sage, a seer, wise.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u 
ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa
verses.en: I stretch the bow for Rudra, so that his arrow may strike the enemy of the sacred word. I rouse the people to strive. I have entered heaven and earth.

verses.sa:
अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन्मम योनिरप्स्व१न्तः समुद्रे ।
ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानु विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonirapsva1ntaḥ samudre 
tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi
verses.en: I give birth to the father at the summit of this world. My home is in the waters, in the ocean. From there I spread through all the worlds, and with my height I touch the heaven beyond.

verses.sa:
अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिना सं बभूव॥
verses.tr:
ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā 
paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ babhūva
verses.en: I breathe out like the wind, embracing all the worlds. Beyond the heavens, beyond this earth, so vast have I become in my greatness.

sections.label: The Ratri Sukta: hymn to Night
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 127
intro: A gentle hymn to the goddess Night, who shines with the stars and gives rest to every creature. Seer: Kushika Saubhara or Ratri Bharadvaji. Deity: Night.

verses.sa: रात्री व्यख्यदायती पुरुत्रा देव्य१क्षभिः । विश्वा अधि श्रियोऽधित॥
verses.tr: rātrī vyakhyadāyatī purutrā devya1kṣabhiḥ viśvā adhi śriyo'dhita
verses.en: The goddess Night has come, looking out in many places with her eyes, the stars. She has put on all her splendours.

verses.sa: ओर्वप्रा अमर्त्या निवतो देव्यु१द्वतः । ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः॥
verses.tr: orvaprā amartyā nivato devyu1dvataḥ jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ
verses.en: The immortal goddess has filled the wide space, the depths and the heights. With her light she drives away the darkness.

verses.sa: निरु स्वसारमस्कृतोषसं देव्यायती । अपेदु हासते तमः॥
verses.tr: niru svasāramaskṛtoṣasaṃ devyāyatī apedu hāsate tamaḥ
verses.en: The goddess, as she comes, has set aside her sister, the Dawn. Darkness too will pass away.

verses.sa: सा नो अद्य यस्या वयं नि ते यामन्नविक्ष्महि । वृक्षे न वसतिं वयः॥
verses.tr: sā no adya yasyā vayaṃ ni te yāmannavikṣmahi vṛkṣe na vasatiṃ vayaḥ
verses.en: So be with us today, you at whose coming we have gone home to rest, as birds go to their nest in a tree.

verses.sa: नि ग्रामासो अविक्षत नि पद्वन्तो नि पक्षिणः । नि श्येनासश्चिदर्थिनः॥
verses.tr: ni grāmāso avikṣata ni padvanto ni pakṣiṇaḥ ni śyenāsaścidarthinaḥ
verses.en: The villages have gone to rest, and all that walks, and all that flies, even the eager hawks.

verses.sa: यावया वृक्यं१ वृकं यवय स्तेनमूर्म्ये । अथा नः सुतरा भव॥
verses.tr: yāvayā vṛkyaṃ1 vṛkaṃ yavaya stenamūrmye athā naḥ sutarā bhava
verses.en: Keep away the she-wolf and the wolf; keep away the thief, O Night. Be easy for us to pass through.

verses.sa: उप मा पेपिशत्तमः कृष्णं व्यक्तमस्थित । उष ऋणेव यातय॥
verses.tr: upa mā pepiśattamaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyaktamasthita uṣa ṛṇeva yātaya
verses.en: Darkness, thick and black and visible, has come close to me. O Dawn, clear it away like a debt.

verses.sa: उप ते गा इवाकरं वृणीष्व दुहितर्दिवः । रात्रि स्तोमं न जिग्युषे॥
verses.tr: upa te gā ivākaraṃ vṛṇīṣva duhitardivaḥ rātri stomaṃ na jigyuṣe
verses.en: I have brought this hymn to you, as one brings cattle home, O daughter of Heaven. Accept it, O Night, like a song of praise for a victor.

sections.label: The Nasadiya Sukta: hymn of creation
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 129
intro: One of the most profound passages in world literature, asking how the universe began, and ending in humble wonder. Seer: Prajapati Parameshthin. Theme: the origin of existence.

verses.sa:
नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् ।
किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम्॥
verses.tr:
nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat 
kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram
verses.en: Then there was neither non-existence nor existence; there was no realm of air, nor sky beyond it. What covered it, and where? In whose keeping? Was there water, deep beyond measure?

verses.sa:
न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः ।
आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किं चनास॥
verses.tr:
na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ 
ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiṃ canāsa
verses.en: There was neither death nor immortality then. There was no sign of night or day. That One breathed, without breath, by its own power. Other than that there was nothing at all.

verses.sa:
तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् ।
तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम्॥
verses.tr:
tama āsīttamasā gūḻhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam 
tucchyenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīttapasastanmahinājāyataikam
verses.en: In the beginning darkness was hidden in darkness. All this was water without any distinguishing mark. That One, which had come into being wrapped in emptiness, was born through the power of heat (tapas).

verses.sa:
कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत् ।
सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन्हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा॥
verses.tr:
kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt 
sato bandhumasati niravindanhṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā
verses.en: In the beginning desire arose in it, desire that was the first seed of mind. Searching in their hearts with wisdom, the poets found the bond of existence in non-existence.

verses.sa:
तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त् ।
रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात्॥
verses.tr:
tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3dupari svidāsī3t 
retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt
verses.en: Their line was stretched across. Was there a below? Was there an above? There were bearers of seed, there were great powers: energy below, impulse above.

verses.sa:
को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः ।
अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाऽथा को वेद यत आबभूव॥
verses.tr:
ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ 
arvāgdevā asya visarjanenā'thā ko veda yata ābabhūva
verses.en: Who really knows? Who here can say from where it was born, from where this creation came? The gods came later, with the creation of this world. Who then knows from where it arose?

verses.sa:
इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न ।
यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद॥
verses.tr:
iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na 
yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomantso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda
verses.en: From where this creation arose, whether it made itself or whether it did not, the one who watches over it in the highest heaven surely knows. Or perhaps even he does not know.

sections.label: The Shraddha Sukta: hymn to Faith
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 151
intro: A short hymn honouring faith as the power behind every true offering. Seer: Shraddha Kamayani. Deity: Faith.

verses.sa:
५ श्रद्धा कामायनी।श्रधा । अनुष्टुप्।
श्रद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते श्रद्धया हूयते हविः । श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयामसि॥
verses.tr:
5 śraddhā kāmāyanīśradhā anuṣṭup
śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi
verses.en: Through faith the fire is kindled; through faith the offering is made. With our words we proclaim faith, at the head of good fortune.

verses.sa: प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः । प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कृधि॥
verses.tr: priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ priyaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvidaṃ ma uditaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Make my words pleasing, O Faith, to the one who gives and to the one who wishes to give. Make them pleasing to the generous worshippers.

verses.sa: यथा देवा असुरेषु श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे । एवं भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कृधि॥
verses.tr: yathā devā asureṣu śraddhāmugreṣu cakrire evaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvasmākamuditaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: As the gods placed faith in the mighty Asuras, so make our words come true for the generous worshippers.

verses.sa: श्रद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते । श्रद्धां हृदय्य१याकूत्या श्रद्धया विन्दते वसु॥
verses.tr: śraddhāṃ devā yajamānā vāyugopā upāsate śraddhāṃ hṛdayya1yākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu
verses.en: The gods and worshippers, guarded by the Wind, honour Faith. People reach Faith through the intention of the heart; through Faith one gains wealth.

verses.sa: श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि । श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह नः॥
verses.tr: śraddhāṃ prātarhavāmahe śraddhāṃ madhyaṃdinaṃ pari śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci śraddhe śraddhāpayeha naḥ
verses.en: We call on Faith in the morning, Faith at midday, and Faith at the setting of the sun. O Faith, fill us with faith here.

sections.label: The Samjnana Sukta: hymn of unity
sections.name: Mandala 10, hymn 191
intro: The closing hymn of the Rig Veda, a prayer for harmony among people. Its words “Come together, speak together” are often recited at gatherings. Seer: Samvanana Angirasa. Deity: Agni and Unity.

verses.sa: संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ । इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर॥
verses.tr: saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā iḻaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara
verses.en: O Agni, mighty one, you gather together everything for the faithful. You are kindled in the place of offering: bring us treasures.

verses.sa: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।  देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते॥
verses.tr: saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate
verses.en: Come together, speak together, let your minds be in harmony, as the gods of old, of one mind, took their share.

verses.sa:
समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् ।
समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि॥
verses.tr:
samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ saha cittameṣām 
samānaṃ mantramabhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi
verses.en: Common be your counsel, common your gathering, common your mind, and united your thoughts. I set before you a common purpose; with a common offering I worship for you.

verses.sa: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति॥
verses.tr: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati
verses.en: Common be your intention, united your hearts, common your minds, so that you may live well together.
